channel.title: Voice of Startup Bangladesh
channel.description: Verified Bangladesh startup, business and investment news

item.title: Abu Manzoor Saif is a successful entrepreneur who left the government job
item.description: Entrepreneur Abu Manzoor Saif is processing Pangas fish to make 'Bacha Fille' (boneless fish meat). He supplies this fillet of fish to various hotels and restaurants in the country, along with business and educational institutions. It is getting huge response.

item.title: Successful startup 'Crack Platoon' in charging station initiative
item.description: The use of electric vehicles is increasing rapidly in the developed countries of the world. Compared to that, the demand for electric vehicles in the country is increasing slowly. Industry stakeholders say that high prices and lack of charging infrastructure are the major reasons for the low interes

item.title: Hundreds of millionaires in one union by farming fish
item.description: Recently, Muhuri river area of ​​Osmanpur Union, West Banshkhali and Patakot can be seen, fish farms have been developed in a wide area. Somewhere the workers are feeding the fish in the farm, somewhere the preparation for fishing is going on.

item.title: Jute export to 30 countries from tin business
item.description: A jute mill inspired by mother is making world class hydro-carbon free bags. Annual income is more than Tk 200 crore in foreign exchange. The rural economy of North Bengal is booming.

item.title: Grameenphone did a business of Tk 11,756 crore in 9 months
item.description: The profit of Grameenphone (GP), the top company in the country's telecom sector, has decreased by Tk 92 crore. In the first 9 months of this year (January-September), the company has made a profit of 2 thousand 172 crores.

item.title: Starting with 10 duck eggs, Bibi Rahima now owns a 16 acre farm
item.description: Bibi Rahima collected 10 duck eggs from a neighbor and placed them under the native chicken in her house for hatching. All the eggs hatched. Then Rahima started rearing these ducklings. Start from there.

item.title: To emerge as a producer and exporter of technology
item.description: Jonaid Saki, Minister of State for Planning, said, 'It is important to create an effective link between business and government with innovation and research. An integrated platform involving government, business and academia is needed.

item.title: IDLC's SME Utsav Loan: Tk 35 lakh available without collateral
item.description: A large part of the country's Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) businesses depend on certain seasons of the year. Clothing is especially dependent on the season as a product.

item.title: Anup bought a computer with tuition money and is now a successful freelancer and entrepreneur
item.description: Anup Kumar Roy, a young man from Shariatpur, who grew up in a family of poverty, dreamed of becoming successful since childhood. And so the urge to stand by the family along with studies made him a hard worker at an early age.

item.title: How Sabbir went viral by making a web app with AI
item.description: Which of the 64 districts of Bangladesh have you visited, it can be seen on the map with one click. You can also download that map with your name.

item.title: Let Your Startup Story Inspire Everyone: Opportunity to Publish Free Articles on 'Voice of Startup Bangladesh'
item.description: 'Voice of Startup Bangladesh' is a leading digital platform for startup, business and technology news in the country.

item.title: Freelancing for wheelchair users, income above lakhs of rupees
item.description: Year 2017 A young man was sitting on the back of a motorcycle in the magical afternoon light. A terrible accident of the moment. That day, which became dark all around, turned the familiar rhythm of Abdul Bached's life upside down.

item.title: Many websites around the world are closed due to fear of cyber attacks, Bangladesh Bank website is closed to avoid attacks
item.description: Various government agencies and commercial organizations around the world have temporarily shut down their websites to avoid the risk of cyber attacks.

item.title: Golden Harvest will hire 200 people, apply without experience
item.description: Golden Harvest Infotech Limited (GHITL) is offering job opportunities without experience. The organization has released a notification to recruit 200 people for their 'Data Entry Operator' post.

item.title: Entropic's record loss: 16.3 billion in revenue in 6 months, but 80.7 billion dollars!
item.description: Anthropic, maker of the popular AI chatbot 'Claude', has faced shocking financial figures for the first half of 2026 (January-June).

item.title: Mariah, a jobless entrepreneur, dreams of a big business in seaweed
item.description: Maria Ray's journey as an entrepreneur started with Sterinus Kitchen in Cox's Bazar. That is in 2022. Basically, he was selling various types of food including sea food or sea fish.

item.title: Shoes made by women in remote villages are going to Europe-America
item.description: Once upon a time, poverty and scarcity were the daily companion of the people of Ghanirampur village of Taraganj, Rangpur. The men of this village used to leave their homes for work to be freed from the scourge of poverty.

item.title: Started with 10 thousand taka, now income is 20 lakh taka per month
item.description: Sirajum Munira and Ferdous Ahmed—both of this couple took jobs in private companies after studying at Dhaka University. But could not adjust themselves at work.

item.title: After Steve Jobs and Tim Cook, which way will John Turnus take Apple?
item.description: Artificial intelligence is the big challenge facing Apple's new CEO John Turnus. With 25 years of experience in engineering and product innovation, John Turnus will have to get up to speed this time.

item.title: Gausul Azam is a successful agricultural entrepreneur at the age of 21
item.description: Rangpur entrepreneur Gausul Azam started his business at the age of 21 with the belief that there is potential in agriculture. In 2017, he started selling agricultural machinery online with pictures and videos.

item.title: Who will give the account of flat, house-car, what assets should be shown in the return
item.description: You have to declare your assets while filing your income tax return. The tax officials ask for a statement of assets to see whether assets are commensurate with income.

item.title: How two brothers got 30 thousand dollars investment in college
item.description: Pithapithi two brothers - Shafi bin Sultan and Sabiq bin Sultan. In their childhood, they did not have any toy cars or 'Aast'. Two together to open the hinge of the car and put it together again...

item.title: Sanjeeda of Jessore, who opened a Facebook ID under a pseudonym and started a business with 2200 rupees, is now a successful entrepreneur.
item.description: The struggle of Sanjida Khatun of Jessore began with this urge to have an identity. There was no shortage in the family, everything was available just by asking the father or husband.

item.title: 18,500 young people from 8 districts want loans to become entrepreneurs
item.description: 18,500 young people from 8 districts of the country have applied to various banks for funding to become entrepreneurs. To develop the youth of the country as entrepreneurs without collateral...

item.title: Bangladesh's clothing exports to the EU have decreased, while China's has increased
item.description: Bangladesh's garment exports to the European Union (EU) market have declined. However, exports to China and Vietnam have increased.

item.title: An investment of Tk 10 lakhs earns Tk 25 lakhs per month
item.description: Summer or winter—there is always more or less demand for Dub. In urban areas, people usually buy dab from vans or specific shops. But what if you order online from anywhere, and the dub comes to you.

item.title: Bangladesh is now seventh in the world in shoe production, followed by China
item.description: Currently the total population of the world is about 828 crores. An average of 3 pairs of shoes were produced for them last year. In total, the production of shoes in the world stands at 2 thousand 460 million pairs.

item.title: The First Domino Question: Is Oracle the Crack, or the Collapse?
item.description: Oracle now carries somewhere between $122 billion and $167 billion in debt, depending on which measure and which quarter you pick. Its credit rating sits one notch above junk.

item.title: From Airtel to Cirkle: Reading the Real Story Behind Robi’s Rebrand
item.description: On 17 August 2026, at a launch event held at the Pan Pacific Sonargaon Hotel in Dhaka, Robi Axiata PLC quietly closed a sixteen-year chapter of Bangladeshi telecom history.
